Authentic Italian food in the heart of Saigon 🇮🇹
Jun 2026 • Friends
Had a great dining experience at Ciao Bella District 1. The restaurant has a warm and cozy atmosphere, perfect for a casual dinner or a relaxing meal with friends and family.

The food was delicious, especially the pasta and pizza — authentic Italian flavors with fresh ingredients and good portions. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made us feel very welcome throughout the meal.

A great place to enjoy Italian cuisine while exploring District 1. I would definitely come back and recommend it to anyone looking for a nice Italian restaurant in Ho Chi Minh City.

Poor food. Very good service
Nov 2025 • Friends
Poor. Im italian. Dont ask me why i ended up there but my friend really wanted to eat italian. The only italian aspect of the restaurant was the vibe. They are proud of a so called “posh carbonara” which is a mix of cacio e pepe and a full English breakfast (with poached egg and parma ham). Frankly just check on youtube how to make carbonara. It’s really not that hard. My friend had fettuccine which was like pho noodles with beef stew. The service was very good though. Super attentive waiters. Really no complains there. Congrats in fact. But the food is not recommended

Lovely gluten free pasta
Aug 2025 • Couples
We had a lovely meal from here! I am a coeliac so I showed the waitress my travel card and she took a picture to show to the chef to make sure he took all safety precautions. She seemed very aware of allergies and notified me that the pastas could be done gluten free. I ordered a creamy spicy chicken pasta which was lovely and the portion sizes were generous. I had no reaction from here and it was reasonably priced! My partner had the spaghetti bolognaise which he really enjoyed (not gluten free).

Hidden gem. Top service, great food and friendly atmosphere. Loved it.
Dec 2024 • Solo
I found this little gem of a restaurant by chance. Heat and fatigue from walking around the city led me to the nearest refuge. How lucky was that?
The food is excellent, simple and delicious. But, it’s the service levels and ambience that make the place soar to uncommon heights. Having been fortunate enough to eat in Michelin star restaurants on several occasions across the years, the attentive but understated service is on a par here. I didn’t feel observed or pressured, but the staff were clearly reading my mind and anticipating my next request. 
Friendly, memorable. Food is not fancy. Just mouth watering.
Highly recommended.
